new.note: Split peas simmered thick with a ham hock, ladled into tin bowls.
new.how: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a splash of oil in a big pot. Add the split peas, ham hock, bay leaves and water and bring to the boil. Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the peas collapse and the soup is thick. Lift out the hock, pull the meat off the bone, shred it and stir it back in. Season and ladle into bowls.

r2.make_ahead: Make up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled; it thickens, so loosen with water when reheating

steps.text: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a splash of oil in a big pot.
Add the split peas, ham hock, bay leaves and water and bring to the boil.
Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the peas collapse and the soup is thick.
Lift out the hock, pull the meat off the bone, shred it and stir it back in. Season and ladle into bowls.

new.veg: Leave out the ham hock and stir in a pinch of smoked paprika.

new.note: White fish, potato and onion in a milky chowder, saltine crackers on the tray.
new.how: Melt the butter and soften the onion. Stir in the flour for a minute. Whisk in the stock, add the potatoes and simmer until just tender. Pour in the milk, add the fish and simmer gently until it flakes. Season. Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.

r2.make_ahead: Make the potato base a day ahead; add the milk and fish on the day

ingredients.item: firm white fish fillets, in chunks

steps.text: Melt the butter and soften the onion.
Stir in the flour for a minute.
Whisk in the stock, add the potatoes and simmer until just tender.
Pour in the milk, add the fish and simmer gently until it flakes. Season.
Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.

new.veg: Use vegetable stock and swap the fish for corn kernels and extra potato.

new.note: Beef and bean chili ladled into bowls, saltine crackers on the tray.
new.how: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic. Stir in the chilli powder and cumin. Add the tomatoes, beans and a cup of water and simmer until thick. Season. Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.

r2.make_ahead: Make up to 2 days ahead; it is better the next day

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic.
Stir in the chilli powder and cumin.
Add the tomatoes, beans and a cup of water and simmer until thick. Season.
Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.

new.veg: Swap the mince for a second tin of beans and a diced capsicum.

new.note: Franks dipped in cornmeal batter and fried golden, yellow mustard to dip.
new.how: Pat the frankfurts dry and push a skewer into each. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt, then the egg and buttermilk, into a thick batter. Pour into a tall glass. Heat the oil to 180C. Dip each frankfurt in the batter and fry, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve with mustard.

steps.text: Pat the frankfurts dry and push a skewer into each.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt, then the egg and buttermilk, into a thick batter. Pour into a tall glass.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip each frankfurt in the batter and fry, turning, until deep golden.
Drain and serve with mustard.

new.note: Beef patties simmered in brown onion gravy, green beans on the side.
new.how: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and shape into 4 oval patties. Brown the patties on both sides and set aside. Fry the onions in the same pan until soft and brown, then stir in the flour. Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire, return the patties and simmer until cooked through. Boil the beans until tender and serve beside the patties.

r2.make_ahead: Shape the patties a day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and shape into 4 oval patties.
Brown the patties on both sides and set aside.
Fry the onions in the same pan until soft and brown, then stir in the flour.
Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire, return the patties and simmer until cooked through.
Boil the beans until tender and serve beside the patties.

new.veg: Use plant-based mince patties and vegetable stock.

new.note: Red beans simmered soft with onion, celery and pepper, spooned over white rice.
new.how: Soften the onion, celery, capsicum and garlic in a little oil. Stir in the Cajun seasoning. Add the beans and stock and simmer, mashing a few beans to thicken. Season. Cook the rice while the beans simmer. Spoon the beans over the rice in small bowls.

r2.make_ahead: Make the beans up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Soften the onion, celery, capsicum and garlic in a little oil.
Stir in the Cajun seasoning.
Add the beans and stock and simmer, mashing a few beans to thicken. Season.
Cook the rice while the beans simmer.
Spoon the beans over the rice in small bowls.

old: Harley's palace tenderloin and red wine

new.note: Chicken, smoked sausage and rice cooked in one pot with peppers and Cajun spice.
new.how: Brown the chicken and sausage in a big pot and set aside. Soften the onion, capsicum and celery in the same pot, then stir in the Cajun seasoning. Add the rice and stir to coat. Add the tomatoes, stock, chicken and sausage, cover and simmer until the rice is tender. Season.

steps.text: Brown the chicken and sausage in a big pot and set aside.
Soften the onion, capsicum and celery in the same pot, then stir in the Cajun seasoning.
Add the rice and stir to coat.
Add the tomatoes, stock, chicken and sausage, cover and simmer until the rice is tender. Season.

new.veg: Leave out the chicken and sausage; use smoked tofu and vegetable stock.

new.n: Corned beef hash with a fried egg
new.note: Corned beef and potato hash fried crisp in patties, a fried egg on each.
new.how: Mash the corned beef roughly with the potatoes and onion, season and shape into 4 patties. Fry the patties in half the oil until crisp on both sides. Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil. Sit an egg on each patty.

r2.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes and shape the patties a day ahead

steps.text: Mash the corned beef roughly with the potatoes and onion, season and shape into 4 patties.
Fry the patties in half the oil until crisp on both sides.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil.
Sit an egg on each patty.

new.veg: Swap the corned beef for grated cheddar and chopped spring onion.

old: Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream

new.n: Angel of Verdun chicken and leek pie
new.note: Chicken and leek in a creamy sauce under a golden puff pastry lid.
new.how: Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leeks and cook until soft. Stir in the flour. Add the stock and cream and simmer until thick. Season and tip into a pie dish to cool a little. Lay the pastry over, trim and brush with beaten egg. Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

r2.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead; top and bake on the day

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leeks and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour.
Add the stock and cream and simmer until thick. Season and tip into a pie dish to cool a little.
Lay the pastry over, trim and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

new.veg: Swap the chicken for mushrooms and use vegetable stock.

old: Gunfire: army tea with dark rum

new.note: Strong black tea stewed in a big pot, sweetened with condensed milk, in metal mugs.
new.how: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water in a big pot until very strong. Stir a tablespoon of condensed milk into each mug and pour the tea over.

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water in a big pot until very strong.
Stir a tablespoon of condensed milk into each mug and pour the tea over.

new.note: Cocoa stirred up from the parcel tins with powdered milk and sugar, hot in tin mugs.
new.how: Mix the cocoa, sugar and milk powder in a jug with a splash of hot water to a paste. Whisk in the rest of the boiling water and pour into mugs.

r2.make_ahead: Mix the dry powder up to a week ahead

steps.text: Mix the cocoa, sugar and milk powder in a jug with a splash of hot water to a paste.
Whisk in the rest of the boiling water and pour into mugs.

new.note: Chicken, egg noodles, carrot and celery in a clear broth, ladled hot.
new.how: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a little oil. Add the stock and chicken and simmer until the chicken is cooked. Lift it out and shred. Add the noodles and simmer until tender. Return the chicken, season and scatter with parsley.

r2.make_ahead: Make the broth a day ahead; add the noodles on the day

steps.text: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a little oil.
Add the stock and chicken and simmer until the chicken is cooked. Lift it out and shred.
Add the noodles and simmer until tender.
Return the chicken, season and scatter with parsley.

new.veg: Use vegetable stock and swap the chicken for white beans.

new.note: Fresh lemonade tinted blue, over ice with a lemon wheel and a cherry.
new.how: Juice 5 lemons and stir with the sugar until it dissolves. Add the cold water and colouring. Pour over ice with a wheel of the last lemon and a cherry.

r2.make_ahead: Make up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Juice 5 lemons and stir with the sugar until it dissolves.
Add the cold water and colouring.
Pour over ice with a wheel of the last lemon and a cherry.

new.note: Ice cream on sponge under a meringue shell, scorched golden in a hot oven.
new.how: Sit the sponge on a lined tray and pile the ice cream on top in a dome. Freeze until hard. Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Spread the meringue over the ice cream and sponge, sealing it to the tray. Bake at 230C until the peaks are scorched golden, then serve straight away.

r2.make_ahead: Build the sponge and ice cream dome up to 2 days ahead and keep frozen

steps.text: Sit the sponge on a lined tray and pile the ice cream on top in a dome. Freeze until hard.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.
Spread the meringue over the ice cream and sponge, sealing it to the tray.
Bake at 230C until the peaks are scorched golden, then serve straight away.
